New faults use the most recently observed status, land, local and RC watermarks; progress cannot reuse pre-fault samples
Temporary at_rest=false and pre-arm authorization withdrawal require safe fresh ground proof before renewed readiness
Unresolved command outcomes and execution integrity blockers retain their original admission restrictions
Recovery and readiness produce no automatic flight commands and use zero thrust
Current IPC FAULT remains visible when aircraft feedback expires; historical IPC cannot revive faults, readiness or arming guidance
Actual-node stop-stream events contain current armed, mode, land, pose and timestamps alongside last committed target
Native JSON and UTF-8 records survive pipe chunk boundaries; oversized output is bounded and explicitly fragmented
